column1: # Partition table for this ESP32-S31 board (16MB flash).
# Per-partition summary:
#   nvs       0x0B000      72 KB  key-value store: Wi-Fi credentials
#   nvs_keys  0x1D000       4 KB  NVS encryption key block (fixed 4096 bytes); idle until enabled
#   otadata   0x1E000       8 KB  OTA boot-slot selector
#   app0      0x20000       3 MB  factory application slot (ota_0)
#   app1      0x320000      3 MB  second OTA slot (ota_1)
#   fatfs     0x620000  9.875 MB  FAT filesystem for logs / media / user files
# Design notes:
# - Partition table offset is 0xA000
column2: not the 0x8000 default: the bootloader starts at 0x2000

column1: #   (ESP32-S31 ROM layout) and CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_USE_FRAME_POINTER makes it about 26 KB
#   which no longer fits in the 24 KB window ending at 0x8000. 0xA000 gives it 32 KB.
#   This offset must match CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET in sdkconfig.
# - No phy partition: ESP32-S31 has an on-chip radio; its PHY calibration is kept in
#   calibration data in nvs / the application.
# - No coredump partition: a snapshot rewrites flash on every panic
#   (watchdog reboot loop) would wear the flash out. Panic logs plus
#   CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_USE_FRAME_POINTER are enough to locate a crash.
# - No padding gap: nvs is 72 KB (0x12000) instead of 64 KB so that otadata ends exactly on

column2: the 64 KB boundary app0 has to start on. The spare 8 KB went into nvs.
